national_traffic_legislation.scope: Extends to the whole of India
national_traffic_legislation.preamble: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to motor vehicles.

sections.title: Short title, extent and commencement
sections.description: This Act may be called the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988. It extends to the whole of India.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicles on public roads in India
sections.enforcement_notes: Central Government appoints commencement date via Gazette notification

sections.title: Definitions
sections.description: Defines key terms used throughout the Act including motor vehicle, transport vehicle, omnibus, goods carriage, etc.
sections.applicability: All sections of the Act
sections.enforcement_notes: Definitions govern interpretation of all subsequent sections

sections.title: Protective headgear for motorcyclists
sections.description: Every person driving or riding on a motorcycle shall wear a protective headgear conforming to the standards prescribed by the Central Government.
sections.applicability: Driver and all pillion riders on any two-wheeled motor vehicle
sections.exceptions: Sikhs wearing turban (state-specific exemptions may apply)
sections.enforcement_notes: Police may issue challan on the spot. Licence suspension for 3 months on violation of 194C (overloading two-wheelers with helmet violation).

sections.title: Duty to give information or report accident
sections.description: Driver of a motor vehicle involved in an accident resulting in death or bodily injury to a person shall take all reasonable steps to secure medical attention and report accident to police.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicle drivers involved in accidents
sections.enforcement_notes: Failure to report is a criminal offence

sections.title: Necessity for insurance against third party risk
sections.description: No person shall use or allow any other person to use a motor vehicle in a public place unless there is in force a policy of insurance complying with the requirements of Chapter XI.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicles used on public roads
sections.enforcement_notes: Compulsory third-party insurance minimum requirement

sections.title: General provision for punishment of offences
sections.description: Whoever contravenes any provision of this Act or any rule or regulation or any order made thereunder shall be punishable with fine which may extend to Rs. 500.
sections.applicability: All general traffic violations not covered by specific sections
sections.exceptions: Violations covered by specific sections attract those specific penalties
sections.enforcement_notes: General catch-all provision for minor violations

sections.title: Rules of road regulation violation
sections.description: Violation of rules of the road regulations including lane discipline, right of way, traffic signals etc.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicles on public roads
sections.enforcement_notes: New section introduced by 2019 Amendment

sections.title: Travelling without ticket
sections.description: Travelling in a public service vehicle without a valid ticket or pass.
sections.applicability: Passengers in public service vehicles
sections.enforcement_notes: Conductor or inspector may issue penalty notice

sections.title: Disobedience of orders of authorities
sections.description: Whoever wilfully disobeys any direction lawfully given by any person or authority empowered to give such direction under this Act.
sections.applicability: All persons subject to the Act
sections.enforcement_notes: Includes refusal to produce documents when demanded by authorized officer

sections.title: Unauthorized use of vehicles without licence
sections.description: Allowing a person who does not hold an effective driving licence to drive a vehicle.
sections.applicability: Vehicle owners and persons in charge of vehicles
sections.enforcement_notes: Owner/custodian is liable even if not present during the offence

sections.title: Driving without licence
sections.description: Driving a motor vehicle without holding an effective driving licence.
sections.applicability: All drivers of motor vehicles
sections.enforcement_notes: Community service may also be ordered under 2019 amendment

sections.title: Driving disqualified / without qualification
sections.description: Driving a vehicle by a person disqualified from holding or obtaining a licence, or without the requisite qualification.
sections.applicability: All drivers
sections.enforcement_notes: Separate from Section 181; higher penalty applicable

sections.title: Oversized vehicles
sections.description: Using a motor vehicle with dimensions exceeding prescribed standards on public roads.
sections.applicability: All vehicles exceeding prescribed size limits
sections.exceptions: Special permits may be obtained for oversized loads
sections.enforcement_notes: New section introduced by 2019 Amendment

sections.title: Driving at excessive speed
sections.description: Driving a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the maximum speed limit prescribed for that vehicle or road.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicles on public roads
sections.enforcement_notes: Speed cameras and electronic challans applicable. Licence suspension under Section 206 for repeat offences.

sections.title: Driving dangerously
sections.description: Driving a motor vehicle in a public place in a manner that is dangerous to the public, having regard to all the circumstances of the case.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicle drivers
sections.enforcement_notes: Licence suspension under Section 206 applicable. Imprisonment up to 6 months for first offence, up to 2 years for subsequent offence.

sections.title: Driving by a drunken person or by a person under the influence of drugs
sections.description: Driving by a person with blood alcohol content exceeding 30mg per 100ml of blood, or under the influence of a drug to such an extent as to be incapable of exercising proper control.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicle drivers
sections.enforcement_notes: Permissible BAC limit: 30mg per 100ml blood. Breath analyser test authorised. Licence suspension under Section 206. Imprisonment: up to 6 months for first offence, up to 2 years for second offence.

sections.title: Speeding/Racing on public ways
sections.description: Participating in a race or trial of speed on a public road without consent of State Government.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicle drivers
sections.exceptions: Officially sanctioned events with State Government permission
sections.enforcement_notes: Licence suspension under Section 206 applicable

sections.title: Using vehicle without permit
sections.description: Using a transport vehicle without a permit or in violation of the conditions of a permit.
sections.applicability: Transport and commercial vehicle operators
sections.exceptions: Vehicles exempted from permit requirements under the Act
sections.enforcement_notes: Applicable to taxis, buses, goods vehicles operating without valid permit

sections.title: Aggregators (violation of licencing conditions)
sections.description: Aggregators who violate the licensing conditions issued by the State Government.
sections.applicability: Ride-hailing aggregators (Ola, Uber, etc.) and their vehicles
sections.enforcement_notes: New section introduced by 2019 Amendment targeting app-based taxi aggregators

sections.title: Driving vehicle exceeding permissible weight
sections.description: Using a vehicle that exceeds the permissible gross vehicle weight or axle weight.
sections.applicability: Goods vehicles and transport vehicles
sections.enforcement_notes: Weigh bridges used for enforcement. Additional fine per extra tonne.

sections.title: Overloading of passengers
sections.description: Carrying passengers in excess of the permitted seating capacity.
sections.applicability: All passenger-carrying vehicles
sections.enforcement_notes: New provision introduced by 2019 Amendment; per-passenger fine applicable

sections.title: Not wearing seat belt
sections.description: Driving or travelling in a motor vehicle without wearing a seat belt as required.
sections.applicability: Driver and all passengers in vehicles fitted with seat belts
sections.enforcement_notes: Applies to both front and rear seat passengers

sections.title: Overloading of two-wheelers / driving without helmet
sections.description: Carrying more than one pillion rider on a two-wheeler or violation of protective headgear requirements.
sections.applicability: Two-wheeler drivers and riders
sections.enforcement_notes: Licence suspension for 3 months applicable in addition to fine. Suspension under Section 206.

sections.title: Not providing way for emergency vehicles
sections.description: Failure to give way to vehicles used as ambulance or for firefighting or for similar emergency services.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicle drivers
sections.enforcement_notes: New section introduced by 2019 Amendment. Licence suspension under Section 206.

sections.title: Driving without insurance
sections.description: Using or allowing use of a motor vehicle in a public place without a valid insurance policy covering third-party risks.
sections.applicability: All motor vehicle drivers and owners
sections.enforcement_notes: Insurance certificate must be carried at all times. Digital copy accepted.

sections.title: Offences by juveniles
sections.description: Motor vehicle offence committed by a juvenile (person under 18 years of age). Guardian or owner deemed guilty.
sections.applicability: Guardians/owners where juvenile drives their vehicle
sections.enforcement_notes: Juvenile tried under Juvenile Justice Act. Vehicle registration cancelled. Burden of proof on guardian/owner.

sections.title: Power of officers to impound documents
sections.description: Authorised officer may seize and retain a driving licence where the licence holder is alleged to have committed an offence under Sections 183, 184, 185, 189, 190, 194C, 194D or 194E.
sections.applicability: All licence holders committing specified offences
sections.enforcement_notes: Suspension of driving licence is the penalty. New provision under 2019 Amendment.

sections.title: Offences committed by enforcing authorities
sections.description: Where any officer entrusted with enforcement of the provisions of this Act is found guilty of an offence, the penalty shall be twice the penalty prescribed for such offence.
sections.applicability: Traffic enforcement officers and authorities
sections.enforcement_notes: Anti-corruption provision new to 2019 Amendment. Creates accountability for enforcement officers.

vehicle_categories.name: Light Motor Vehicle
vehicle_categories.definition: Motor vehicle with gross vehicle weight not exceeding 7500 kg

vehicle_categories.name: Two-Wheeler / Motorcycle
vehicle_categories.definition: Motor vehicle with two wheels including motorcycles, scooters and mopeds

vehicle_categories.name: Heavy Goods Vehicle
vehicle_categories.definition: Motor vehicle designed to carry goods with GVW exceeding 12000 kg
vehicle_categories.insurance_requirements: Mandatory third-party insurance + goods in transit insurance recommended

vehicle_categories.name: Medium Passenger Vehicle
vehicle_categories.definition: Omnibus or vehicle designed to carry passengers between 7500 kg and 12000 kg GVW

vehicle_categories.name: Public Service Vehicle (Bus)
vehicle_categories.definition: Motor vehicle adapted to carry more than 6 passengers for hire or reward
vehicle_categories.licensing_requirements: Driving Licence — HMV + PSV Badge + Route Permit

vehicle_categories.name: Aggregator / App-Based Taxi
vehicle_categories.definition: Motor vehicle providing transportation services through a digital platform/app aggregator
vehicle_categories.licensing_requirements: Driving Licence — LMV + State Aggregator Licence

jurisdiction_hierarchy.description: Rule resolution follows strict geographic hierarchy. Lower-level rules supplement but cannot contradict higher-level rules.

levels.name: State
levels.override_power: Can supplement national law; can set stricter (but not weaker) standards
levels.known_state_overrides: DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE — contact respective State Transport Authority

levels.name: District
levels.override_power: Can impose local restrictions; cannot dilute State/National rules

levels.name: Municipality / City
levels.override_power: Local parking, speed, and zone restrictions only

jurisdiction_hierarchy.precedence_rule: In case of conflict, higher-level rule prevails. State-specific fine reductions post-2019 amendment adopted by some states are valid under Section 200 compounding powers.

state_overrides.note: Several Indian states adopted reduced compounding fines under Section 200 (Section 85 of Amendment Act). Full confirmed state-level data requires direct verification with respective State Transport Authorities.
state_overrides.detail: DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE — each state issues separate notifications. Refer State Transport Authority gazette notifications.

Repeat offence fines for Section 185 (drunk driving): Rs 15,000 cited in some sources, Rs 10,000 in others for first offence. Rs 15,000 marked as repeat offence fine pending official gazette confirmation.
